name: Butter Croissant
description: Flaky, golden croissant laminated with 82% butterfat for a crisp, honeycomb interior. Best eaten warm on the day it is baked.

name: Pain au Chocolat
description: A buttery viennoiserie wrapped around two bars of dark chocolate. The layers shatter when you bite into them.

name: Shokupan Milk Bread
description: A soft, cloud-like sandwich loaf made with the tangzhong method. It stays moist for days and makes excellent toast.

name: Melon Pan
description: A sweet bun with a crisp, cookie-like top that cracks in a melon-rind pattern. The soft inside is lightly vanilla-scented.

name: Country Sourdough Loaf
description: A rustic loaf with a deeply caramelized crust and an open, chewy crumb. Fermented 24 hours for a tangy flavor.

name: Rye Sourdough Boule
description: A dense, dark loaf inspired by German rye breads, with a hint of caraway and a moist crumb. Pairs well with cured meats and cheese.

name: Matcha Basque Cheesecake
description: A burnt-top cheesecake with a creamy, custard-like center, flavored with ceremonial-grade matcha. Serves 8 to 10 people.

name: Lemon Tart
description: A buttery sablé shell filled with silky lemon curd and finished with a light torch. Sharp, bright, and refreshing.

name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie
description: A chewy cookie with browned butter, brown sugar, and generous chunks of dark chocolate. Crisp at the edges and soft in the middle.

name: Hojicha Cookie
description: A tender cookie made with roasted green tea (hojicha) powder, giving a toasty, smoky flavor. Lightly sweetened.

name: Japanese Curry Bread
description: A bread roll filled with thick Japanese curry, coated in panko, and fried until golden. Mild and comforting.

name: Rosemary Focaccia
description: A pillowy Italian focaccia with olive oil, flaky sea salt, and fresh rosemary. Good on its own or with soup.
